name: Run Away Together
oracle_text: Choose two target creatures controlled by different players. Return those creatures to their owners' hands.
blocked_sentences: Choose two target creatures controlled by different players. Return those creatures to their owners' hands.

needs.what: a target spec of an exact size (count: 2, every target required) whose chosen targets must be controlled by pairwise different players -- i.e. `one_per_player` allowed on a fixed-size spec, so the spell is cast only when two creatures with different controllers exist and fizzles per-target normally
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `one_per_player` is refused by the loader (cards/loader/targets.py) unless the size is caster-picked (`count: "any"` or `up_to`); `count: 2, up_to: true` would let the spell be cast at zero or one creature, and `min_count: 2` under a ceiling of 2 is refused (a floor at or above the ceiling). Two separate specs (one `controller: you`, one `controller: opponent`) are narrower than the card: in a multiplayer pod it can return creatures of two different opponents, or of you and one opponent, which a fixed you/opponent split cannot offer
